'''Amy''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was paired up with a loved one during the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Festival of Love]].

==Biography==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[L-O53]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with finding a loved one for Amy. After searching the cities of [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]] and [[Kaadara]] during the Festival of Love, the spacer found a companion who shared similar interests with Amy.

==Behind the scenes==
Amy was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. She was in the game during the Ewok Festival of Love celebration of [[2011]]. During the event, players could pair up Amy, as well as several other NPC's, with companions who shared similar interests.
